# JNPR® Club

> JNPR® Club is the studio of Mariana Ortega, a Creative Director based in Madrid, Spain. Branding, art direction, campaigns, websites that clients own (no monthly fees) and AI images and video. Clients include Real Madrid, Miravia and Pocoyo.

JNPR® Labs is the AI and web side of the studio: AI imagery and video directed by a designer, and websites moved out of Wix or Squarespace into the client's own name, which the client edits themselves, from €490 as a one-off payment.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://jnpr-club.com/): who Mariana is, featured projects, JNPR® Labs
- [Portfolio](https://jnpr-club.com/work/): brand, web, campaigns, motion and editorial work
- [About](https://jnpr-club.com/about/): Mariana Ortega, Creative Director
- [Websites you own](https://jnpr-club.com/websites/): copy of your Wix or Squarespace site in your name, from €490
- [Spanish version](https://jnpr-club.com/es/)
